request.style: English, lullaby sung by a father, a soft low male voice, fingerpicked acoustic guitar and a faint harmonium, slow rocking 6/8, tender and safe, 60 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
Lay your head down, little one
The lamps are low, the day is done
The Lord who made the hills and sky
Is watching you, and so am I

[Chorus]
He will not slumber, he will not sleep
The one who keeps you, he will keep
Your going out, your coming in
Sleep now, sleep again

[Verse]
The sun won't hurt you through the day
The moon won't harm you on your way
The Lord will keep you from all harm
Asleep within his arm

[Chorus]
He will not slumber, he will not sleep
The one who keeps you, he will keep
Your going out, your coming in
Sleep now, sleep again
